title: Give static narration retakes new immutable audio URLs
acceptance: A changed encoded recitation take has a new content-addressed URL; previously published audio bytes remain at their old paths.
Both static recitation authoring commands publish the returned audio path, keep phrase lookup keys and timing metadata, and retain already generated files without unnecessary synthesis.

No production audio regeneration, voice/provider switch, account/session/entitlement change or paid call occurs in this source change. Listening quality and a later audio release require separate evidence; source integration follows the coordinating release lane.

evidence.note: Public HEAD at 2026-10-27T00:22Z: 200 audio/ogg, Cache-Control public,max-age=31536000,immutable; release.txt cff309ee209d88c5d1684c9d46dc3730218eb0c7. This establishes cache policy, not a demonstrated stale browser cache.
